purpose: Reliable per-slot run evidence with one final GitHub write, separate scan/evidence semantics, priority recovery of missing receipts, and no automation self-disabling.

receipt_authority.post_cutover: The deterministic final per-slot receipt is authoritative persisted run evidence. Legacy aggregate heartbeat files are not completeness authorities after cutover.
receipt_authority.retain_history: History is the set of individual final receipt files. Never reconstruct or rewrite prior receipts to append a new run.

write_protocol: Derive the nominal Europe/Madrid slot and deterministic receipt path before scanning, but do not write RUNNING.
Perform scan, coverage classification and ledger read/classification first.
At end write one complete final receipt. If path exists from an idempotent retry, fetch/update only that same slot with its current SHA.
If final write fails, retry once. Never revert to aggregate heartbeat writes and never invent evidence.
Receipt-write failure is receipt_persistence_status=FAILED and does not retroactively mean the scan did not run.
Never disable, pause, delete or change an automation schedule because of receipt, ledger, config, source or GitHub failures.

safety_scan_complete_requires: required recovery attempts executed according to priority
Safety final receipt successfully persisted or separately marked receipt_persistence_status=FAILED
completion_semantics.rule: If scheduler/task evidence proves a radar scan ran but its receipt is missing, classify RECEIPT_EVIDENCE_GAP, not execution gap. Safety itself may be scan_status=COMPLETE while gap_resolution_status is PARTIAL or UNRESOLVED.
does_not_require: successful persistence of non-alert-critical ledger backfills

missing_receipt_recovery.priority_rule: When any current RECEIPT_EVIDENCE_GAP exists, defer noncritical ledger backfills and routine source-health recoveries until all such gaps have received the fullest feasible recovery in the current Safety pass.
missing_receipt_recovery.recovery_action: If exact employer coverage cannot be reconstructed from surviving evidence, re-scan the full configured 66 for that radar with up to 72h lookback. Search for qualifying Madrid roles first, then complete the lossless 66-ID recovery map as far as technically possible.
missing_receipt_recovery.multiple_gap_rule: For multiple current evidence gaps, process all affected radars before noncritical work. If full lossless reconstruction cannot finish, persist which employer IDs were recovered and which remain unresolved; do not collapse the entire radar to a generic unresolved range.
missing_receipt_recovery.after_successful_recovery: Record evidence_gap_status=RECOVERED and preserve that the original receipt was missing. Do not repeatedly warn the same recovered gap.
missing_receipt_recovery.warning: Use EVIDENCE RECOVERY WARNING when a scan is known to have run but its final receipt is missing and recovery remains unresolved after priority recovery. Use WATCHDOG/COVERAGE WARNING only for true current execution/control gaps.

automation_liveness.rule: All Madrid radar, Safety Net and Daily Audit automations remain enabled across transient failures. Only explicit user action may disable them.

fresh_radars_immediate_write_required_fo: qualifying fresh new requisition that is or will be alerted
Alerted=true persistence for a qualifying fresh alert
material state change needed to prevent immediate duplicate-alert inconsistency
do_not_require_immediate_write_for: newly observed requisition already outside the radar freshness window
old nonqualifying inventory discovered during a scan
canonical URL correction with no alert consequence
ledger_backfill_policy.noncritical_handling: Store as ledger_backfill_candidates. Pending noncritical backfills are lower priority than current evidence-gap recovery and do not make scan_status INCOMPLETE.
ledger_backfill_policy.critical_write_failure: Use state_persistence_status=CRITICAL and LEDGER STATE WARNING only when fresh alert/new requisition/Alerted state cannot be safely persisted and immediate dedup/alert consistency is at risk.
